summary: Recorded DL-126 as resolved: Jared confirmed in chat on 2026-09-27 the design lead's answer to his card p08 question. ELI5 keeps a project-level default that applies everywhere in the project; the ELI5 control in a chat overrides it for that chat only (chat override, else project default, else the app default); switching changes only replies written after the switch and never re-sends, regenerates or rewrites earlier replies, so no second response is produced; each finished reply may offer Explain this reply simply, which writes one extra reply only when asked; ELI5 is its own small popup with the quick dot by the message box as the one-click on and off; Expert and ELI5 dual copy only for tooltips and help; the guided tour is re-pointed to the popup and the dot. Compiled by this ledger as ACD-484, F3-581 and ATS-065 with in-place amendments; the project scope of the ELI5 default is a Settings follow-up (q-015) and the tour re-point an obligation on the tour owner (q-016).
